allocation.summary: A 9-name book: SPY 20% ballast plus 8 survivors spread across seven sectors (max 2 in Electronic Tech and Technology Services), with the megacap-tech/AI cluster (NVDA+MSFT+GOOGL+AMZN) deliberately held to 41%, under the 48% cap. Conviction was set from multi-sleeve strength and then scaled by each name's entryHaircut, so the extended-tape names (MSFT, JPM, GOOGL, CNQ-class entries) carry reduced weights with reachable near-spot zones rather than being dropped — CNQ (duplicate energy leg with the worse entry and richer P/B than SHEL) and V (lowest composite, ~1:1 R:R, structural take-rate compression) were the two cut on conviction and sector-slot grounds, not entry alone. Posture is moderately defensive for a momentum-led tape: 20% index, 10% cheap-cycle energy (valuation 7.8), a bank, an aerospace industrial, and vol-scaled sizing that keeps the widest-range name (LLY, range/price ~0.49) at 8% despite its top composite.
